Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: no bill limit
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Workbenches accept up to 999 bills instead of 15.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: cleaning priority
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Cleaners start with the kitchen and the infirmary, then the dining and recreation rooms, and only then the rest of the ship.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: treat first
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: A button on each colonist marks them to be treated before anyone else.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: smooth walls before floors
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Smoothing work does the walls of a cell before the floor, so nobody stands on a floor that will be dug again.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: clean before cooking
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Cooks clean a dirty kitchen before they start a meal.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: automatic research
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: When no project is chosen, researchers pick one of the three cheapest available ones by themselves.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: move a patient
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Right-click a free bed with a doctor selected to carry a patient there.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: linked planters
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: A button on hydroponics and planters copies the plant choice to every connected planter of the same kind.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: quick cargo stockpile
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: A button on cargo modules turns the whole room into a stockpile in one click.
